ValidationRule.description: Requires the Sub Status field to be filled in if the lead is set to Nurture Low
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Nurture low"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Sub_Status__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( First_Activity_Date__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in the Sub Status field.
